recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source fix is needed unless the work group later chooses to prefer explicit CodeSystem/v2-0532 concepts over importing ValueSet/v2-0136 as a style decision; the current source resolves the missing-CodeSystem problem without removing the used value set.
issue_request: FHIR-37453 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab technical correction raised against R4B and applied for R5. It reported that ValueSet/yesnodontknow referred to missing terminology.hl7.org CodeSystem/v2-0136 and requested that the CLD use http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0532.
initial_application: Commit d06598d8f7b1 applied the issue by replacing the compose include with explicit Y and N concepts from CodeSystem/v2-0532. Follow-up terminology QA, especially 7e10f14f4489, corrected the checked-in expansion to CodeSystem/v2-0532, and later metadata cleanup preserved a compose import of the existing THO ValueSet/v2-0136 rather than the missing CodeSystem/v2-0136.
additional_context: The value set source is part of the current examples surface through source/valueset/list-ValueSet-examples.xml and is referenced by Questionnaire examples. The linked Zulip terminology thread clarified that v2-0136 is a ValueSet, not a CodeSystem, and the 2022-08-22 Vocab minutes record FHIR-37453 as resolved change required while rejecting FHIR-27788's earlier removal direction because the value set is used.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source/valueset/valueset-example-yesnodontknow.xml compose imports http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v2-0136, its expansion contains Y and N from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0532, and it does not contain http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0136.

related_jiras.note: Earlier request to remove or repair the oddly rendered yes-no-dontknow example was ultimately Resolved - No Change because the value set is used, supporting retention of the value set while avoiding the missing CodeSystem reference.
